approved_by: maintainer (thresholds proposed in session and accepted)
change_rule: Changing a value needs a new version of this file, a written reason, and maintainer approval. A failed gate never justifies loosening a threshold.
metric: CIEDE2000, kL = kC = kH = 1, CIELAB D50 for both gates
pass_rule: Every limit must be met on held-out data only. Training numbers are reported but never count toward a pass.

calibration.description: Z30 DCP render vs ColorChecker SG published reference values, held-out capture.

look.description: Lightroom render with the fitted stock profile vs SpektraFilm render of the same NEF, held-out scenes.

scene_groups.description: Scenes have no chart, so look-gate groups are assigned from the SpektraFilm reference block's own CIELAB D50 value. Defined before any measurement.
scene_groups.unit: 16x16 RAW-pixel blocks after registration; blocks with internal luminance spread above max_block_spread_L or outside the L range are excluded as edges or clipped.
